text.content:
Half the factories closed this year. Maelstrom moved into the shells.

Region: Watson (district E). Was: northern Watson Development, the east side of the NorCal base
Controlled by: Corporate security inside the fences (Moderate rules); Maelstrom between them (Combat rules)
The feel of it: Fences, empty plants, weekend Night Markets, and a lot of borrowed industrial equipment
Notable locations: Totentanz (#8), the All Foods Plant (#9), Petrochem Refinery (#74), SovOil Refinery (#75), the Sphere Plants
Danger: Combat / Moderate. SC 4 (site security only, Medium). UC 6

For a decade Co-Prosperity Sphere factories made good jobs here. Half of them closed in 2070, and the rest run behind their own fences with their own guards. Shift workers live in company dorms and squatters in the closed plants. The NCPD drives through with the windows up. Night Markets fill the empty factories on weekends.

Recent History

  • 2052: The Totentanz moves here from the edge of the Hot Zone.
  • 2060–2068: The Sphere's plants open: Northside's decade of good jobs.
  • 2069–2070: Half the plants close. The All Foods protein plant is abandoned with the vats still full, and Maelstrom moves in.

Places

  • All Foods Plant (#9). SC 4: Maelstrom. A dead protein plant with rotting vats; Maelstrom's chop shop and initiation ground.
  • Petrochem Refinery (#74). SC 9. Still running CHOOH2 and fuel. Maelstrom taps its pipelines.
  • SovOil Refinery (#75). SC 7. Half-closed; SovOil pays nobody, and its guards take bribes.
  • The Sphere Plants. SC 3–8. Twelve factories, half of them closed.

Getting There

NCART: Industrial North, All Foods (Northern Line, Crosstown, Westbrook Express).

Turf

Maelstrom.

People

  • Chrome Mother (Ganger 7, Maelstrom). Runs the Totentanz this year.
  • Akio Fujimoto (Exec 5). The last Sphere plant manager in Northside, trying to keep his factory open with no money left.
  • Pig Iron (Nomad 3). Strips the closed plants for parts to sell in Arroyo, and knows every way in and out.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.08
